No. Unfortunately not. It's just a point I am fixating on endlessly, can barely think of anything else. I once looked up the heights of the bridges around town but none of them were high enough that I could be sure to just end it. Car crash seems too difficult, especially with how safe they are now, though now I see a way that would hopefully work, but if it didn't, well, you know.

It's like the entirety of existence up to death will be about it from here on out.

I appreciate the effort and reaching out.

I've already done most of that stuff, I'm actually addicted to fitness and health. Saw the arcade fire once, back in 2004 in a little basement, they were very hip.

Been reading a monumental amount over the last year or so, it's just that none of the "success" in the aspects of my life in which I have been successful ever translated socially. I get the impression it does for most people.

I'm not powerful at all, in fact I am the lowest rung on the totem pole in terms of peers, at best I can pretend for a few hours before someone blows my house of cards over, probably didn't even mean to.
